body.heading: Where in the world is Albania?
paragraphs: Albania is a country in Southern Europe, which is part of Europe.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Albania is Tirana.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Albania is Albanian.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Albania is the Albanian lek.

body.heading: How big is Albania?
paragraphs: Albania covers about 29,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Croatia.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Berat's white Ottoman houses climb a hill toward a castle where people still live — their rows of windows gave the town its nickname.
Albania's Ionian coast has turquoise bays and island-dotted beaches at Ksamil and Himara, beneath the dramatic Llogara mountain pass.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Albania on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
